fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-06-20, around 11:30, a neighbour allegedly obstructed access and used abusive language towards the complainant near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore on repeated occasions, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-20. The complaint was lodged by Jagan Sekar (9000000355). Gopal Muthu (9000000403), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A person named Senthil Krishnan, associated with the number 9000000461, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement, social media screenshots and photographs.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Witness statement; Social media screenshot; Photograph
fields.Modus_Operandi: Neighbour allegedly used abusive language during a continuing dispute.
